question:
Simplify the given expression.

(z(x³−y³))/(x²+x y+y²)+(x(y³−z³))/(y²+y z+z²)+(y(z³−x³))/(z²+z x+x²)
solution:
**Concept:**

a³ - b³ = (a-b)(a² + b² + ab)

**Solution:**

Given,

(z(x³−y³))/(x²+x y+y²)+(x(y³−z³))/(y²+y z+z²)+(y(z³−x³))/(z²+z x+x²)

⇒ (z(x−y)(x² +y² +xy))/(x²+x y+y²)+(x(y−z)(y² +z² +yz))/(y²+y z+z²)+(y(z−x)(x² +z² +zx))/(z²+z x+x²)

⇒ z(x-y) + x(y-z) + y(z-x)

⇒ zx - zy + xy - xz + yz - yx

⇒ **0**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 1.**
